name: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation (NFWF)
collect_note: Reads NFWF's Apply for a Grant page twice a day: its Announcements table lists every new Request for Proposals, and the full proposal date is read from each RFP page (up to five per run); RFQs and contracting notices are filtered out, and new calls wait for review because the programs range from shorebirds to working lands.

sample.title: Great Plains Grassland Fund 2026 - 2027 Request for Proposals
Atlantic Flyway Shorebird Initiative 2027 Request for Proposals

evidence: GET https://www.nfwf.org/apply-grant HTTP 200 text/html 2026-11-12 (https://www.nfwf.org/grants redirects there): Announcements table (view block-5) lists 5 posts, 4 of them RFPs/RFQ; Due Dates table (block-6) lists upcoming full proposal dates. RFP page for Great Plains Grassland Fund HTTP 200 shows 'Full Proposal Due Date: January 27, 2027'. rss.xml exists but carries only program documents and grant slates; sitemap lists 2617 mostly press releases; no JSON API, no Grants.gov listing (NFWF is not a federal agency).
